{{SameName|Demon|[[Demon (Nightmare Carnival)|Nightmare Carnival]] • [[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Demon|Pizza Party]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date = 9th of November 2019|event = [[Halloween 2019 Event]]}} {{For|the [[Crook Boss]] [[Crook Boss/Gallery|skin]] or [[Gladiator]] [[Gladiator/Gallery|skin]] of the same name|[[Demon Swing]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Demon |image1 = Demon2025.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Halloween 2019 Event|Halloween 2019]] |first_wave_appearance = 7 (Originally) |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]450 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |spawned_by = [[Jack O' Bot]] |hidden = No |immunity = {{Attr|Burn}} }}__TOC__ ==Description== The '''Demon''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It can be considered the first non-major "boss" that appeared on the map due to its high health. It had more health than the [[Scarecrow (Nightmare Carnival)|Scarecrow]], but was also slightly slower than it. The '''Demon''' was immune to the [[Pyromancer]]'s burn (and therefore slowdown). The '''Demon''' could have also been spawned by [[Jack O' Bot]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The Demon has a red, hell-like appearance. It has a dark red granite torso and even darker granite red legs. Its head and arms are light red. It has dark red granite wings on its back and grey horns with red details on top of its head. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Demon''' is similar to the second version, except it had a snarling demon face with red eyes. }} ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nightmare Carnival]] is listed instead. *You should get as many [[Minigunner]]s as soon as possible to deal with the '''Demon''' due to its health and high speed. *You can use the [[Freezer]] to slow down the '''Demon'''. **The [[Pyromancer]] cannot be used to slow this down. It can still attack the '''Demon''', but it will only deal non-burn damage. *The [[Military Base]] can help weaken the '''Demon''', but it is not reliable enough as its [[units]] have a slow spawnrate. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Demon.png|First version (18 October 2019 – 9 November 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyDemon.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyDemonIconIG.png|'''Demon''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The face used by the '''Demon''' was the {{RLinkC|128992838|Beast Mode}} face from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Demon''' may loosely be based on ''Tower Battles's ''[[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Demon|Demon]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.1|Release v1.1.0]] **'''Demon''' added. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **'''Demon''' removed. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Demon''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Demon]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from [[Pizza Party]]. **Due to changes made with updates, its face has been removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{NightmareCarnival|[[Scarecrow (Nightmare Carnival)|Scarecrow]]|Wave 5|Demon|Wave 7|[[Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)|Ghost]]|Wave 9}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Demon}} [[Category:Sandbox Only]]
